name: 일레븐
visual_review: 밝게 열린 눈·웃는 입·핑크 트윈테일과 버거 포크가 분명히 읽힙니다. 회복 강화 상태 발동 후 양손 휘두름·버거 생성·회수의 실동작이 다릅니다.
motion_summary: Eleven pink twin-tail cheerful burger streamer with giant burger fork weapon from portrait. Official R is a regenerating powered-up state that creates burgers through basic attacks, NOT a giant magical vortex. Animate bright ready stance; bracing giant fork; pumping free fist; warm golden-green vitality pulses around her boots; one broad two-handed burger-fork swing; return wind-up; second compact swing; small cute burger pops near fork tip; catching momentum with knee bend; proud fork raise; settle; ready. Preserve big happy open eyes and playful small smile, white/pink clothes. Two tiny burger icons and warm gold healing sparks only, not UI, no healing text.
